set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Use cases, formula, domain, numerical risks, and compatibility are documented.
- Prototype is benchmarked and differentially tested on positive/near-zero costs.
- Implementation requires explicit contract, oracle, adversarial tests, and baseline.
- Otherwise a decision record defers it and APIs reject clearly.
- Support tables reflect the decision.
set.title: Evaluate KL structural loss and implement only if justified
